scripts.build: npm run build:workspace && npm run build:canvas && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p dist/drizzle dist/web && cp -R drizzle/. dist/drizzle && cp -R web/. dist/web && mkdir -p dist/src/workers && cp src/workers/*.mjs dist/src/workers/
scripts.build:canvas: npm --prefix ../prototype/canvas-lab run check && npm --prefix ../prototype/canvas-lab run build && mkdir -p web/canvas && cp -R ../prototype/canvas-built/. web/canvas/
scripts.build:workspace: npm --prefix ../frontend run check && npm --prefix ../frontend run build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p dist/workspace dist/src/workers && cp -R ../frontend/dist/. dist/workspace/ && cp src/workers/*.mjs dist/src/workers/ && node scripts/copy-search-vendor.mjs
